class.name: IfcPostalAddress
class.brief_description: Definition: The address for delivery of paper based mail. HISTORY New entity in IFC Release 2x.

members.member: An organization defined address for internal mail delivery.

The postal address. NOTE: A postal address may occupy several lines (or elements) when recorded. It is expected that normal usage will incorporate relevant elements of the following address concepts: A location within a building (e.g. 3rd Floor) Building name (e.g. Interoperability House) Street number (e.g. 6400) Street name (e.g. Alliance Boulevard). Typical content of address lines may vary in different countries.
An address that is implied by an identifiable mail drop.
The name of a region. NOTE: The counties of the United Kingdom and the states of North America are examples of regions.
The code that is used by the country's postal service.
